# Symphony Draw

> Symphony Draw is free browser-based lighting plot software for placing fixtures, patching rigs, and creating professional plots and paperwork.

Symphony is the platform. Symphony Draw is the drawing tool. It is free to use. These are the public pages. The editor and account pages are not listed here.

## Pages

- [Symphony Draw — Free Lighting Plot Software](https://plan.symphony-app.com/): Symphony Draw is free browser-based lighting plot software for placing fixtures, patching rigs, and creating professional plots and paperwork.
- [Pricing](https://plan.symphony-app.com/pricing): Draw a plot and print the sheet for free. Extras are not for sale yet.
- [About Symphony Draw](https://plan.symphony-app.com/about): Symphony Draw is a lighting plot for lighting designers who want the hang on paper.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://plan.symphony-app.com/faq): Short answers on drawing a plot, a guest sheet, and keeping it.
- [Privacy notice](https://plan.symphony-app.com/privacy): How Symphony looks after an account, a plot, and a donation.
- [Terms and conditions](https://plan.symphony-app.com/terms): The terms for using Symphony to draw a plot.
- [Donate](https://plan.symphony-app.com/donate): Enjoying Symphony? Fancy getting me a drink?
